game.name: The Legend of Zelda: Dungeons of Infinity and Beyond
game.desc: Patch for the PortMaster 1.1.6 VM build that fits 4:3, 16:9 and other screens. A classic Zelda HUD keeps health, magic, the equipped item, and counters visible. On wide screens the equipment, minimap, and dungeon panels sit beside the playfield; click the right stick to show or hide them. Select + Start exits.
